text_block_list.text:
The new year has begun.
Starting this year, Satono Crown
enters the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Crown's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year,
Trainer-sama.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You can be more relaxed, Trainer.
Now then, raise your glass—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

On this day, Satono Crown invited me
to the Satono Group's New Year's party.
Aside from members of the Satono family, invited guests and reporters had gathered at the venue.
choice_data_list: Incredible. Even stars and politicians are here...
Wow. Even celebrities and politicians are here...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of stars,
I've also invited someone I really look up to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu. And whom might you be referring to?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san!

The one who appeared before my eyes was Mejiro McQueen.
The supreme stayer representing the Mejiro family,
one of the most prestigious bloodlines in the Umamusume world...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It seems you're attending in your racing outfit rather than a dress this year, Crown-san. It suits you well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I am honored to unveil the proof that
I am permitted to run in the GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san! Me too!
I'll be able to wear my racing silks soon too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. McQueen-san. Dia is finally showing signs of coming into her prime."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my...!
What delightful news.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Even the Mejiro family
has come to celebrate with the Satonos...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I knew all eyes would be on Crown-san!
She is a candidate for this year's Triple Crown Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mother. Your glass is empty.
Shall I bring you another drink?
And some food while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Crown's Mother
text_block_list.text: Well... could you, please?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Come help me, Trainer.
I don't think I can carry all the way to the plates on my own.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll help out.
Yeah, I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. There, all done.

Satono Crown smiles contentedly,
though neither a glass nor a plate of food is in her hands yet.
choice_data_list: What about your mom's drink?
What about your mother's drink?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'll bring it over in a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"‘The one McQueen has her eye on is Satono Diamond.’
Only after everyone recognizes that, you see."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Because ever since we were little, Dia has always adored McQueen-san."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The "Virtuoso" Mejiro McQueen.
The legend who won the Kikuka Sho
and claimed two victories in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of rivals...
the 'Emperor' Tokai Teio is a famous one."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
By the way, around the time Dia started looking up to McQueen-san,
it seems her best friend also found someone to look up to.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Can you tell?
Yes, the one Kita-san looks up to is McQueen-san's
rival, Teio-san! Fascinating, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So even those two best friends would
sometimes argue when it came to their
favorite Umamusume idols.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Teio is stronger!"
"No way, McQueen is way stronger!"
We'd go back and forth like that until sundown.

Satono Crown narrows her eyes
as she fondly recalls memories of Satono Diamond.
...Like a girl who stood outside that circle.
choice_data_list: Which Umamusume do you look up to?
Who is the Umamusume you look up to?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Well, there isn't one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I've looked at past GⅠ-winning Umamusume and searched for someone to admire, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I could find someone who makes my eyes light up like Dia,
maybe I'd get even more motivated.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Because I heard that having someone like that makes an Umamusume stronger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That there must be an Umamusume who clicks with me too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Turns out, dreams aren't something
you can pursue with that kind of calculated mindset.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "...That's why I want to cherish it! Any treasure that Dia managed to find!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! My bad.
I'm not the type of Umamusume who can talk about herself at times like this.
choice_data_list: ...That's not true.

text_block_list.text:
The words slipped out before I could stop myself.
I didn't want Satono Crown calling herself a "nameless Umamusume."
choice_data_list: You have what it takes to be admired yourself
On the contrary, you have the power to be admired by others.
Let's rest a little longer. I want to hear you talk.
Let's rest a little longer. I'd like to hear your story.
Because you have the skill to overturn that disadvantage!
Because you have the skill to overturn that disadvantage!

text_block_list.text:
The words slipped out before I could stop myself.
I didn't want Satono Crown calling herself a "nameless Umamusume."
choice_data_list: You have what it takes to be admired yourself
On the contrary, you have the power to be admired by others.
Let's rest a little longer. I want to hear you talk.
Let's rest a little longer. I'd like to hear your story.
Because you have the skill to overturn that disadvantage!
Because you have the skill to overturn that disadvantage!

text_block_list.text:
Even without an Umamusume to look up to,
Satono Crown has the qualities to be admired by others.
choice_data_list: There's no Umamusume more captivating than you
There's no Uma Musume more charming than you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...!
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's no greater bliss as an Umamusume.
To be loved so deeply by one's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ......Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Trainer.
Shall we head back to Mom and Dia soon?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just put some assorted pinchos on a plate for me.
Mama's the type who wants to try all kinds of flavors.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Satono Crown-san!
Perfect timing.
I'd like to introduce our newcomer to you.

"...That was merely regarding the horse girl she admired.
On any other topic, Satono Crown
has plenty she can talk about."
choice_data_list: Which G1 does Satono Crown like, huh?
Which G1 does Satono Crown like?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're giving me a topic that's *too* easy to talk about;
it's actually putting me on the spot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's see~
Can I include overseas races in this?

And so, while leaning against the wall, I chatted
and laughed with her for a while—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Trainer.
Shall we head back to Mom and Dia soon?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just put some assorted pinchos on a plate for me.
Mama's the type who wants to try all kinds of flavors.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Satono Crown-san!
Perfect timing.
I'd like to introduce our newcomer to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Ehh? You're saying not having someone to look up to is a disadvantage~?
choice_data_list: Umm, that is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then again, looking at it from another angle, maybe it's adversity.
If she has it and I don't, then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'd better make the absolute most of this situation♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Trainer.
Shall we head back to Mom and Dia soon?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just put some assorted pinchos on a plate for me.
Mama's the type who wants to try all kinds of flavors.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Satono Crown-san!
Perfect timing.
I'd like to introduce our newcomer to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate
text_block_list.text:
Crown! That race the other day was truly splendid!
The Satono family's first GⅠ Umamusume is surely a future Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh my, thank you very much, everyone!

Returning to the center of the party venue,
Satono Crown was quickly surrounded
by a circle of people.

The spotlight belongs solely to her.
No matter what rivals stand before her,
no matter what background they come from—
choice_data_list: (――She is the true star.)

text_block_list.text: I believed—truly believed—that no one could surpass Satono Crown once she stepped onto the stage.
